PRE-PROPOSAL SCIENTIFIC AND TYPE HOLD on exact 245b01374d144deb8fb2f9477d73d9fb3f7d801f over e584ad6. This is an exact-export review of an unregistered commit, not a candidate review or state mutation.

BLOCKER 1 - ValidatedBuild authority is still caller-mintable. ExtendedBuildReceipt and its nested BuildReceipt are public product data. AcquisitionViewAuthority.validatedBuild at acquire/output.scala:864-877 and joinedSource at :946-955 check only StoryId plus source checksum; they do not establish that a build ran or that BuildReceipt.stages agrees with ExtendedBuildReceipt.stages. AdmittedViewBasis.fromAcquisition at view/output.scala:1010-1027 then publishes ViewBasis.ValidatedBuild from that wrapper. A temp-only external-behaviour probe constructed a BuildReceipt claiming a never-run stage, paired it with an empty ExtendedBuildReceipt.stages vector and Long.MinValue timestamp, and successfully obtained AcquisitionViewAuthority, a valid AcquisitionAccount, and BasisAuthority.ValidatedBuild. This is the same caller-selected-license class that the chief correctly rejected for human and fixture authority. Conservative bar: either admit a genuinely checked/verifiable build receipt and prove the join, or do not issue ValidatedBuild authority from this public product.

BLOCKER 2 - a valid BeforeIntake refusal has no public decode path. SourceOutcome.Refused(RefusedSourceProgress.BeforeIntake, failure) is admitted domain data and encodes. Bare StoryOutputResultCodec.decode delegates to the always-refusing contextual SourceOutcome decoder at codec/output.scala:801-805 and output_acquire.scala:332,719-725. The byte-context overload calls admitSourceOutcome, whose refused branch unconditionally requires progress.original at output_acquire.scala:347-356; BeforeIntake has none. A temp-only probe built a valid source-refused, universe-unestablished, semantic-refused StoryOutputResult, encoded it, and proved both decode(text) and decode(text, emptyBytes) return Left. The v2 codec is therefore not round-trip total over its own admitted domain. It needs an explicitly checked metadata-only BeforeIntake branch or another public contextual route, plus a positive round-trip court and mutations that reject invented completed intake.

NON-BLOCKING SCOPE CORRECTION - changing only ArtifactRef.byteLength for a KnownPayloadRef while preserving schema/checksum is accepted. The 245 handoff says every payload length is joined, but the exact chief disposition requires schema/checksum for Known and adds byte length only for retained unsupported payloads. I therefore do not use this as a ruling blocker; the handoff should narrow its claim unless chief broadens the contract.

Executable receipt: exact archive /private/tmp/storymodel4s-output-245-review.k71oUp; temp-only test-file SHA-256 values 0da0907bec656b3be14a640aa4c12aa3b248ff4694887c34f0b717867b9d869a for view OutputSuite and c15994606c52ea2e08b2c34674c577c4ffe864219194cc0e1c647747e079a529 for codec OutputCodecSuite. Command: sbt -batch viewJVM/testOnly storymodel4s.view.OutputSuite codecJVM/testOnly storymodel4s.codec.OutputCodecSuite. Results: view 23/23, codec 10/10, exit 0. Passing means the attack receipts reproduced. Shared checkout and reserved paths were not edited; no candidate was registered.
